        How to read a price band

        A band is one trade on one job.

        Every band on this site comes from a job worksheet, read per trade. Choose a line of the job below to see its band on the ladder.

        Job worksheet · APS-4867

        Each figure is that job’s own amount for that trade. A siding-and-painting job contributes its siding amount to the siding figures and its painting amount to the painting figures.

        • +
          Materialscounted in the band
        • +
          Laborcounted in the band
        • −
          Discountsnot applied: the band is before discounts
        • −
          Sales taxexcluded

        “1,590 individually priced trades on 886 documented projects, 2018–2026: a documented sample, not every job since 2009.”

        The line the price bands carry, as published. Jobs whose per-trade split could not be verified are left out entirely. The median band is the band holding the middle job; the middle half is where half of the jobs landed.
